messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — summary of today's ACME onboarding call. They called out a couple of onboarding blockers that are bubbling into renewal risk if we don't address or clearly document workarounds. Looping in @tomas and @alex for prioritization.

Priya (CSE): Quick notes from call: 
- SSO SAML timeouts causing multi-step reauth for new users (esp. admins)
- No per-route cost breakdown in Console, product team wants to see token cost per route for forecasting
- First-request latency spikes when model cold starts; customers see 2–3s delays on some routes
- Need easy CSV export of usage + tags for finance handoffs

Leo (AE): Customer asks (verbatim): "we need per-endpoint cost views, exportable monthly, and an admin onboarding checklist so our ops team can spin up service without your support". They specifically called out wanting to see how embeddings vs generation compare on cost.

Tomas (PM): Thanks — couple of clarifying Qs: 
1) Is the SSO problem reproducible for any user or only specific IdP configs?
2) For per-route cost, do they need token-level breakdown or just aggregated by route?

Priya (CSE): SSO seems IdP-specific (Okta with short session TTL), reproduced on two different accounts at ACME. Per-route: finance asked for aggregated by route but we should include token-level in export for accuracy.

Alex (Eng): For latency cold-starts there's a known warmup gap on small dedicated pools. Workaround: enable lightweight prefix caching and set pre-warm to 2 replicas for their busiest routes. Example config we used for Beta:
```
route: /sales-assist
prewarm: 2
caching: prefix_kv
priority: low-latency
```
Also we can add an internal note on SSO: session_refresh config can be increased at tenant level; ops can apply asap.

Tomas (PM): Sounds like 3 discrete asks: (A) SSO session/timeout doc + tenant knob (short term), (B) per-route cost export (product work), (C) onboarding checklist & CSV export (UX/CS). Propose triage: A = P0 (small change + doc), B = P1 (needs backend + Console work), C = P2 (UX flows + templates). Agree?

Maya (CS): I agree with that prioritization. Customer said renewal conversation in 6 weeks — if we have A done and a clear ETA for B they might extend.

Leo (AE): Can we show them a mock CSV today? Even a templated sample would buy time.

Alex (Eng): I can generate a sample CSV from their sandbox logs — will attach in thread when ready. ETA: today EOD.

feedback-bot: New feedback ticket created: FB-1289 — "ACME onboarding: per-route cost export & SSO session doc" (assigned to @tomas).

Tomas (PM): Putting FB-1289 in triage board. @maya @priya can you add repro logs for SSO and a sample of the CSV columns ACME expects? That will help scope B.

Priya (CSE): Adding Okta logs + sample export columns to the ticket now. Columns: date, route, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_usd, model_variant, tenant_tag.

Maya (CS): Action items: 
- Alex: sample CSV + workaround steps (EOD)
- Priya: upload SSO repro logs + CSV columns to FB-1289 (today)
- Tomas: triage FB-1289 and provide dev ETA for per-route export (by EOD tomorrow)
- Maya: schedule renewal check-in with ACME in 5 weeks with updates

Maya (CS): Also tagging risk level: renewal-risk=high until we have B ETA. Please update the ticket status when ETA is posted. :eyes:
